Method of Attack: Malicious Android apps that secretly display advertisements while the phone's screen is off, running down device battery
Adware hidden in Google Play apps impersonating TV/DMB Player, Music Downloader, News, and Calendar apps
Adware apps wait several weeks before activating ad-fraud activity to evade detection
Remote modification and update of adware configuration via Firebase Storage or Messaging
Prompting users to add apps as exclusion to Android's power-saving system to run in background
Fetching and loading advertisements while device screen is off to fraudulently generate revenue
Requesting permission to draw over other apps (though no phishing observed)
Attack Vector: Malicious apps distributed via Google Play Store
Indicators of Compromise: High battery consumption while device is idle
Apps requesting permission to draw over other apps
Apps prompting to be added as exclusion to Android power-saving
Ads loading briefly when device screen is turned on before auto-closing
